notes: Filenames are the dataset's own image indices (e.g. 00000011_006.png), so each file is traceable to the source collection. CC0 imposes no condition — no attribution is legally required and commercial use is unrestricted — but the credit line is displayed anyway, and the record exists so the licence sweep can verify rather than assume.
